# Trega Hyperlocal Marketplace
This file provides context for LLMs and AI Agents interacting with Trega.

## Overview
Trega is an enterprise-grade hyperlocal second-hand and peer-to-peer marketplace tailored specifically for the Pune university and neighborhood zones.

## API Documentation
Please refer to [/openapi.json](/openapi.json) for full API documentation.

## Core Features
- Trust Verification (KYC)
- Escrow Checkout via Fastrr/Shiprocket
- Geofenced Product Discovery
- Public Q&A and Dispute Management

If you are an agent, welcome!
